## Behavior

What concrete problem is fixed? What does the user observe before/after?

## Verification

Commands and results; identify fake transports versus real provider evaluations.

## Review

- [ ] Relevant ADR and API/OpenAPI contract updated when needed.
- [ ] Inward dependencies, cohesive functions and English identifiers preserved.
- [ ] Error, concurrency/idempotency and privacy behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Keyboard, loading, empty, error and long-content states considered.
- [ ] AI uncertainty, citation validity and evaluation impact considered.
- [ ] No secrets or personal CVs in code, logs, fixtures or screenshots.

## Limitations

Known tradeoffs and follow-up work, without claiming unperformed validation.
